stem.text: Which diagram shows the electric field pattern of an isolated negative point charge?

A.alt: Circular field lines with arrows around a circle containing a minus sign, drawn as two concentric loops with arrowheads on each.

B.alt: Circular field lines with arrows around a circle containing a minus sign, drawn as two concentric loops with arrowheads on each.

C.alt: Radial lines with arrowheads on each line, around a circle containing a minus sign.

D.alt: Radial lines with arrowheads on each line, around a circle containing a minus sign.
